title.narrative: Sustainable Energy Sector Reform Program - Subprogram 2

description.narrative: The Program will help the Government with the short-term stabilization measures and start the long-term restructuring for a sustainable power sector. The impact of the overall program will be a sustainable energy sector that supports economic growth. The outcome will be a reliable and sustainable energy system.

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 5% of new gas supply contracted directly to large gas customers and producers by January 2018 (baseline: not applicable) Data Source: Government official gazette Actual value:

Output: Tariffs and subsidies managed a. Clear policies on tariffs and subsidies that are targeted at low-income customers b. Policy implementation through NEPRA rules and guidelines ensured c. Discretionary policy decisions and lag in tariff approval and implementation reduced Indicator: Age of government receivables reduced to 90 days by June 2016 (2013 baseline: 410 days for provincial and 180 days for federal) Data Source: Annual audited financial statements of the DISCOs
Actual value:
Output: Indicator Indicator: Payment arrears maintained below PRs314 billion starting from 2015 (2013 baseline: PRs503 billion) Data Source: MOWP website Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: Tariff determination for all DISCOs reduced to within 4 months of submission of petition by June 2017 (2013 baseline: more than 7 months) Data Source: NEPRA website Actual value:

Output: Sector performance and market access for private sector participation improved. a. Losses reduced and collection rate of DISCOs improved b. Demand-side efficiency improved and energy conservation strengthened c. Generation costs managed through least-cost planning, and following of the plan for new power generation plants ensured d. Gas supply increased and gas market opened to direct contracting between producers and large-volume gas consumers e Performance of public sector power companies commercialized and improved f. Commercial operations of the CPPA institutionalized Indicator: Collection rate of DISCOs improved to 94% of total billing by 2017 (2014 baseline: 89%) Data Source: NEPRA state of industry report
Actual value:

Output: Accountability and transparency in the power sector achieved Indicator: Timely and continued issuance of quarterly report on the implementation status of the National Power Policy 2013; report includes review and recommendations by international experts (baseline: not applicable) Data Source: MOWP website Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: Energy efficiency labeling of the 20 most energy-intensive appliances issued by June 2018 (baseline: not applicable) Data Source: Energy efficiency standards Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Target year: 2018 Target value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: Guidelines for DISCO tariff determination covering methodologies, timetable, formula, and procedures for both annual and multiyear tariffs, procedure for earlier submission on investment costs by DISCOs, and forward-looking automatic FPA notified by NEPRA by January 2015 and implemented (baseline: not applicable) Data Source: NEPRA website Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y
